title: Styio task/resource product delivery
goal: Current-source build confirmation → known-defect repair → real three-repository integration → one final applicable regression.
success: All confirmed in-scope issues are closed with current evidence.
The shared project works through the real three-repository product path.
Existing supported behavior has applicable final regression coverage; no unexecuted or skipped claim is passed.
The declared supported-capability inventory reconciles with current regression and integration evidence; missing coverage or unresolved failures cannot establish full usability.

architecture.summary: Language semantics belong to Styio; package/workspace workflows to Pafio; product interaction and daemon consumption to Vityo.

delivery_policy.activation: The current joint milestone is authorized for execution (2026-10-11). Its coordinator admits only work with satisfied dependencies; future outlines remain inactive. A phase execution is not milestone delivery.
delivery_policy.integration: One cross-repository coordinator; one source writer per repository; no overlapping duplicate tasks.
delivery_policy.external_join: Cross-repository handoffs are explicit coordinator conditions, not same-Tree after edges. Never mark them scheduler-enforced.
delivery_policy.milestone_integrity: Each delivered milestone leaves the integrated product buildable and usable, preserves every previously supported capability in the declared support scope, and delivers the selected new behavior end to end. Complete all affected producers, consumers, entrypoints, contracts and tests together. A partial migration, disabled existing feature, temporary broken interface or deferred required wiring is not a delivered milestone. Preserve independently retained assets and user data.
delivery_policy.parallelism: Future outlines are not ready-to-run work. An empty requires list does not establish safe concurrency: elaborate actual dependencies and exclusive write ownership first. The current three repository baselines may run concurrently; upstream-dependent checks wait for reviewed handoffs. Keep one source writer per repository for this milestone. Different repositories may run final regressions concurrently only after the common E2E join and source review, without competing source edits.

requirements.statement: Build the selected working tree, including uncommitted changes, before interpreting old reports. Record source revision, changed paths, build configuration and actual executable; reuse valid incremental builds.

Close confirmed in-scope defects before integration. Classify each reported issue as repaired, not reproduced with current evidence, or a concrete unresolved semantic decision. An unresolved defect affecting supported behavior prevents delivery.

Use the same source-built Styio and Pafio candidates through actual Vityo production services and vityod; cover success, compile failure, repaired success, task settlement and stale-result isolation. Mocks alone cannot establish this claim.

After scoped fixes and source review, run each applicable complete engineering suite once. Reuse still-valid results; repair ordinary failures and rerun affected checks. Skipped, unavailable and unexecuted checks are not passes.

Stop at engineering completion. No automatic next milestone, publication, installation, real Agent development task, graphical source editing or deletion of Prototype. Text is the authoring surface; graphs are read-only.

Each investigation must name one source-level behavior, compiler optimization or toolchain change, its closest existing method, an executable counterexample and acceptance evidence. Novelty is not a prerequisite to useful engineering; no measured benefit means no optimization claim.

A task reading bounded i64 history sees the committed history at task creation. Parent writes after creation do not change the captured version. Preserve history order, lifetime, failure settlement and supported alias behavior.

Confirm nested pending-write ownership and explicit task-order behavior against existing D4/D5 contracts. Repair violations throughout semantic analysis, lowering and runtime; do not invent multiwriter merge or rollback of external I/O.

Each delivered milestone leaves the integrated product buildable and usable, preserves every previously supported capability in the declared support scope, and delivers the selected new behavior end to end. Complete all affected producers, consumers, entrypoints, contracts and tests together. A partial migration, disabled existing feature, temporary broken interface or deferred required wiring is not a delivered milestone. Preserve independently retained assets and user data.
